Tensorlake Cloud APIs for Document Ingestion, Serverless Workflows, and Sandboxes. The Document Ingestion API parses documents (PDF, images, office formats) into layout-aware Markdown and structured chunks, performs schema-guided structured extraction and classification, and manages reusable files and datasets. Parsing runs as an asynchronous job: a parse request returns a parse id (job id) that is polled for results or delivered via webhook. All requests are authenticated with an API key passed as a Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer tl_apiKey_...).
